query:
SELECT to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "key!",
       COALESCE(SUM(call_count), 0)::bigint AS "call_count!",
       COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0.0)::float8 AS "cost_usd!",
       COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "prompt_tokens!",
       COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "completion_tokens!",
       COALESCE(SUM(reasoning_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "reasoning_tokens!",
       COALESCE(SUM(call_count) FILTER (WHERE model LIKE 'codex/%' OR model LIKE 'claude/%'), 0)::bigint AS "subscription_call_count!"
  FROM llm.daily_spend
 WHERE day >= $1 AND day <= $2
 GROUP BY to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
 ORDER BY to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
